info.name: PANNs Cnn10 transfer
info.description: Freezes an AudioSet-pretrained PANNs Cnn10 backbone and trains a two-layer head on its 512-d embedding. Expects log-mel input from the PANNs log-mel processing block; the stock MFE block is a different front end and will not reproduce these scores.

parameters.name: Epochs
parameters.help: Head-only training passes. The backbone is frozen, so this is cheap: the embeddings are computed once up front and reused every epoch. 100 rather than 60 because label smoothing needs the longer schedule to pay off - epoch-matched over 15 seeds, ls=0.1 is worth +0.85 points overall at 100 epochs but only +0.36 (sem 0.26, i.e. noise) at 60. On its own the epoch count barely matters: 30 through 250 all land within seed noise.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: Adam step size for the head. Matches the harness's MLPClassifier learning_rate_init.

parameters.name: Backbone
parameters.help: Cnn10 (6.3M params) scored 92.1% on the project's frozen test split against Cnn6's 91.9%, averaged over five seeds. Cnn6 is slightly cheaper per inference.

parameters.name: Balance classes
parameters.help: Oversample minority classes to the majority count. The project's corpus is imbalanced and chainsaw recall is the metric this most affects.

parameters.name: Label smoothing
parameters.help: Softens the one-hot targets. Measured over 15 seeds on a 738-window validation split, and the effect depends on the epoch count. At 100 epochs, 0.1 is worth +0.85 points overall and +1.79 points of chainsaw recall, both real. At 60 epochs the overall gain washes out into noise (+0.36, sem 0.26) but the chainsaw gain survives (+1.08, sem 0.54), and 0.05 recovers slightly more of it (+1.43). Either way this is the only change out of 34 configurations tried that moved the weakest class - mixup, focal loss and class weighting all did nothing or hurt. Leave weight decay at its built-in 1e-3: dropping it is a comparable gain alone, but the two over-regularise together and chainsaw recall falls back below baseline.

parameters.name: Random seed
parameters.help: Fixed so a rerun reproduces the reported scores rather than landing somewhere in the seed spread.
